messages:
alex: Idea: add a \"snapshot\" affordance in the route inspector that captures current filters + pinned models + sampling/qos settings and gives a sharable URL. Useful for reproducing telemetry views across teams.

tasha: Nice. two quick concerns: (1) cost estimation when someone publishes (they think it's light but sampling changes everything), (2) filter stability if we store human text.

rafael: For (2) we should store normalized filter tokens + stable ids and not raw SQL. Backend can return a hydrated expression for UI with `?hydrate=true`.

meera: UX: Make two modes: \"Share link (ephemeral)\" -> creates a tokenized URL valid 7 days; \"Publish snapshot\" -> saves immutable snapshot in org-level saved views. Default to ephemeral.

alex: Agreed. For publish flow I want a cheap dry-run to estimate token cost and whether routing falls back to cheaper model variants. Sketch: POST /api/console/snapshots -> {scope, route_id, model_pins, filters, sample_rate} returns {id, estimate_tokens, routing_hints}.

rafael: Implementation notes: use precomputed per-route histograms to estimate tokens instead of executing queries. Also resolve model pins to exact model_versions on publish to avoid drift. Store soft refs for ephemeral.

tasha: Also add quota guardrails: if estimate_tokens > quota_remaining*0.8 warn and require owner approval to publish. For orgs with dedicated capacity, optionally auto-approve.

meera: In the UI show a small badge on charts when a snapshot is sampled: \"view uses 1% sample (1k/100k)\". And in the publish modal show a diff compared to live (est tokens vs live avg).

alex: Example API contract proposal in the modal:
```
POST /api/v1/console/snapshots
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"scope\": \"route\",
  \"route_id\": \"r-88\",
  \"model_pins\": [\"m-3@v12\"],
  \"filters\": [\"status:500\",\"latency>200\"],
  \"sample_rate\": 0.01,
  \"publish\": true
}
```
Response:
```
{ \"id\": \"snap-900\", \"estimate_tokens\": 98765, \"warnings\": [\"est 2.6x baseline\"], \"model_version_mismatch\": [] }
```

rafael: +1 but rename `model_pins` -> `model_version_ids` when publish=true. Keep `model_pins` allowed for ephemeral. We need the GET /snapshots/:id?hydrate=true permissioned endpoint.

tasha: Ops: also we should rate-limit snapshot dry-run calls per org to avoid accidental heavy scanning. maybe 10/min.

meera: Small UX ask: quick-copy button for ephemeral links which auto-includes a one-line preview (filters + sample). Also show a compact permalink to embed in docs.

deploy-bot: Feature flag rollout scheduled: console.snapshot-share -> canary orgs on 2024-06-07T14:00:00Z.

alex: Thanks all. I'll write a short RFC with proposed API shapes, quota checks, and UI mock. tagging infra for histograms and billing for the dry-run estimator.

rafael: Tiny security note: ephemeral URLs must be unguessable (token length) and respect org membership on access.

meera: And add a small telemetry event: `snapshot.created` (mode: ephemeral|published, estimate_tokens, sample_rate).

alex: Great. I'll post RFC in #design and follow up with a short beta invite list.
